payload.title: Anth.us: authored pages as content, retire anthus_pages.py (phase f)
payload.description: Phase f of PPY-e329c3, not done. Home, about, engage, ai-solutions, ryan, decision-models, benchmarks, platform index and product chrome are Python HTML (anthus_pages.py 1136 lines, solution_marks.py, arcade_pictograms.py, inquiry_form.py). PPY-d16f64 (include construct, design only) is not implemented, and nothing in core can express the arcade hero, pictogram, case-card or capability-card compositions as Markus content. Until the include construct and block vocabulary exist, these pages can only move into hooks.py page_body functions (same code, not retired). Production copy rules apply to any move: memory notes on featured solutions, Primus credibility section, footer Auritus logo, Built and run for years, free and open source wording, claims honesty.
